title: Lake Hartwell Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: Recent updates in 2025 include: Brand new upper and lower decks with new outdoor furniture including a new dining table for 8, 2 new poly Adirondack chairs on upper deck, new outdoor sofa and chair set up on lower deck, 4 new high chairs for a great viewing spot of the lake! Recent updates in 2022 include: New Hardwoods throughout Main Level + Master Retreat and New Quartz Countertops in the Kitchen Located on the South Carolina side of Lake Hartwell, our lake house features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, sprawling decks, a screened in porch, hot tub, and private dock for your enjoyment. We are 15 minutes by boat to Clemson and a great house to stay at for a game! The open living space on the main level offers an eat-in kitchen with dining space for 6, fully stocked kitchen and additional dining space at the formal dining room for 6 more people. The living room has a beautiful stone fireplace and an additional sitting space for 4 more that makes for a perfect place for game nights! The main living and dining space opens up to the sprawling back deck with outdoor dining space for 6, a gas grill and Adirondack chairs that will quickly become a favorite spot to enjoy your morning coffee. Up just a few stairs to the master retreat complete with a KING master bed and private bath with dual vanities, jacuzzi tub, and separate shower. A custom walk-in closet was just updated May 2020. Downstairs from the main living space is the additional 2 guest bedrooms. Both QUEEN bedrooms that share another full bath with dual sinks and shower/tub combo. Down one more short flight of stairs, you will find the basement game room with additional living space, sleeper sofa, another stone fireplace, pool table, game table, bar and additional fridge. The laundry room is also on this level. Off the basement is the screened porch with outdoor lounging space and hammock. Stairs from there take you down to the lake and dock. Don't forget to stop halfway down and enjoy a little hot tub time! Our lake house is in a private cove with deep water which offers a quiet place to swim, fish, or just enjoy the views. Rent a boat and feel free to dock it at our dock. Our house is easy to get to just about anywhere on the lake. Come for a long weekend or better yet - a Clemson game weekend or enjoy a summer week here. We hope you enjoy our home away from home as much as we do!
